description: The source reports progress and observations at the Whitesands pilot of the Toe to Heel Air Injection process. Descriptors include annual reports for 2007–2009, with the 2009 report also labelled final, and supplementary archives for 2007 and 2008. This is a physical extraction-process information source. Measured recovery, operating conditions and economic calculations are not exposed in the inspected metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The licence and reuse terms are not stated. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above.
